research_title: Software factory evals and hooks research for Waymark

scope.implementation_status: Source research only; no Waymark change proposed or made
scope.license_status: Observed source terms, not a rights audit or dependency selection

agents: hooks: Claude Code, Codex and Copilot hook, permission and CLI docs, Codex source at rust-v0.166.0, Matt Pocock's hook material, and Waymark's role invocations; also read this machine's user-level agent configuration (reported to the user, not recorded here)
evals: Anthropic and OpenAI eval guidance, SWE-bench audit papers and issues, mutation testing, Gremlins, evalite, Waymark metrics and trial records, and read-only counts from local factory databases
community: popular hook enforcers, eval harnesses and self-evaluating factories at pinned commits
method.root: Lead session read the course page, cloned mattpocock/course-video-manager, skills, sandcastle and dictionary-of-ai-coding with hooks disabled, and read the factory workflows, sandcastle scripts and prompts, hook settings, retro and writing docs, and dictionary entries. Queried PR history with gh. Wrote the Matt Pocock, Waymark and verdict sections.
method.review: Every claim used for a recommendation was rechecked by the lead against the primary source (see web_sources notes, the gh api checks in other_repositories, and Waymark lines). Links to local files, section anchors and line ranges into the four cloned repositories were checked mechanically.
method.limits: Read-only. No hook, agent, eval, probe or package was run. OpenAI's SWE-bench page refused automated fetches. Vendor docs carry no version. The course lessons are unreleased.
